algolia.name: HTC - RE 16.0-Megapixel Waterproof Digital Camera
algolia.description: Be ready to capture special moments with this HTC RE digital camera, which allows 1-handed operation and features a grip sensor that turns the camera on automatically when it is picked up. The 16.0MP CMOS sensor delivers crisp, detailed images.
